recipes.name: Healthiest Ever Granola
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C)*.
In a large bowl, combine all the dry ingredients.
In a small food processor, blend all the wet ingredients until smooth.**
Add the date mixture to the bowl of dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
Spread the granola evenly on the baking tray. Bake on the centre rack of the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring once or twice throughout.
Once lightly golden, remove the granola from the oven. Let cool completely, then transfer to an airtight container or large glass storage jar. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** Tahini consistency can vary between brands—some are thick, while others are thin. If your tahini is on the thicker side, consider adding a small splash more water to reach the desired consistency. However, be cautious not to add too much water, as this can result in overly soft granola when stored.
Storage Store sealed on the counter for up to 2 weeks.
